sans.$description: Default typeface stack for all UI text and body copy.

mono.$description: Monospace stack for code, tabular numbers, and technical identifiers.

xs.$description: Smallest legible size for fine print, badges, and dense metadata; step -2 on the brand modular scale.

sm.$description: Secondary text and dense UI such as table cells and helper text; step -1 on the brand modular scale.

md.$description: Base body size for paragraphs, labels, and control text; step 0 (the brand type-scale base).

lg.$description: Emphasized body text and small headings; step +1 on the brand modular scale.

xl.$description: Section headings and dialog titles; step +2 on the brand modular scale.

2xl.$description: Page headings; step +3 on the brand modular scale.

3xl.$description: Display and hero headings; step +4 on the brand modular scale.

regular.$description: Default weight for body copy and most UI text.

medium.$description: Slight emphasis for control labels, buttons, and selected items.

bold.$description: Highest emphasis; reserve for display headings and critical highlights.

tight.$description: Compact line height for headings and single-line controls.

normal.$description: Default line height for body copy and multi-line text.

loose.$description: Airy line height for long-form reading and spacious layouts.
